title.narrative: Intra-ACP GCCA+ COMESA Climate Change Programme

description.narrative: The present contract will implement the Intra-ACP Global Climate Change Alliance Plus programme in Eastern Africa. The project aims to build capacity at regional and national level for better responding to climate change-related challenges in the area, to improve the policies at regional level, to coordinate the climate action in Eastern Africa and to scale up climate projects from the previous phase of the Intra-ACP GCCA Programme.
